svg.text: Cone 140 across the bottom, 340 across the top, 220 tall.

svg.text: Flat pattern: a ring sector, inner radius 169, outer radius 411,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 149 degrees, plus a 15 mm seam lap. Roll, rivet the seam, seal.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom: a 140 mm disc with a 32 mm hole, riveted and sealed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Feed pipe 44 x 6, 145 long, welded or bonded under the hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screen: 2 mm punched stainless sheet in a 360 mm flat bar rim,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: resting on the hopper rim (lifts off for cleaning).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cone drops into the support ring and wedges there.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pipe end is 15 above the lid and over the bowl centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: water poured in runs out of the pipe with none at the seam.
